name: What is the process for scheduling a water softener repair service?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for scheduling a water softener repair service?

acceptedAnswer.text: To schedule a water softener repair, contact CG Plumbing Solutions by phone or through our website. We'll gather basic information about your system and the issues you're experiencing, then arrange a convenient appointment time for a technician to visit your home in areas like Henderson or Paradise. Our team will assess the unit, explain the problem, and provide a clear repair plan before proceeding.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contact us by phone or website to schedule. We'll gather information and arrange a visit to your home. A technician will assess the unit, explain the issue, and provide a repair plan.
